ui-color-scheme.$description: The color scheme in force: `light`, or `dark` under `prefers-color-scheme: dark`. `html` reads it as its `color-scheme`, `.ui-light` and `.ui-dark` set it on a part of the page, and `Typography` reads it in a style query. Set the classes, not the token.

ui-palette-chroma.$description: Chroma of the palette source color, as a multiplier of `0.21`.

ui-palette-hue.$description: Hue of the palette source color in degrees. `222.8` (blue) by default, in both color schemes.

ui-palette-hue-rotate-by.$description: Hue drift per palette step in degrees: each step rotates one more time than the last, so `1` spreads 15° across the ramp. The severity scopes use `1` for livelier tints, the brand palette `0`.

ui-palette-source.$description: The source color the palette is derived from. Set it to replace `--ui-palette-hue` and `--ui-palette-chroma`. Any color works: the palette keeps its oklch hue, scales its chroma and sets the lightness per step. See [Palette](/guide/theming#palette).

ui-gray-chroma.$description: Chroma of the gray ramp. Raise it for tinted grays.

ui-color-1.$description: Step 1 of the palette, at 98% lightness.
ui-color-1.$value: oklch( from var(--ui-palette-source) 98% calc(0.03 * (c / 0.21)) calc(h + (0 * var(--ui-palette-hue-rotate-by))) )

ui-color-2.$description: Step 2 of the palette, at 97% lightness.
ui-color-2.$value: oklch( from var(--ui-palette-source) 97% calc(0.06 * (c / 0.21)) calc(h + (1 * var(--ui-palette-hue-rotate-by))) )

ui-color-3.$description: Step 3 of the palette, at 93% lightness.
ui-color-3.$value: oklch( from var(--ui-palette-source) 93% calc(0.1 * (c / 0.21)) calc(h + (2 * var(--ui-palette-hue-rotate-by))) )

ui-color-4.$description: Step 4 of the palette, at 84% lightness.
ui-color-4.$value: oklch( from var(--ui-palette-source) 84% calc(0.12 * (c / 0.21)) calc(h + (3 * var(--ui-palette-hue-rotate-by))) )

ui-color-5.$description: Step 5 of the palette, at 80% lightness.
ui-color-5.$value: oklch( from var(--ui-palette-source) 80% calc(0.16 * (c / 0.21)) calc(h + (4 * var(--ui-palette-hue-rotate-by))) )

ui-color-6.$description: Step 6 of the palette, at 71% lightness.
ui-color-6.$value: oklch( from var(--ui-palette-source) 71% calc(0.19 * (c / 0.21)) calc(h + (5 * var(--ui-palette-hue-rotate-by))) )

ui-color-7.$description: Step 7 of the palette, at 66% lightness.
ui-color-7.$value: oklch( from var(--ui-palette-source) 66% calc(0.2 * (c / 0.21)) calc(h + (6 * var(--ui-palette-hue-rotate-by))) )

ui-color-8.$description: Step 8 of the palette, at 58% lightness.
ui-color-8.$value: oklch( from var(--ui-palette-source) 58% calc(0.21 * (c / 0.21)) calc(h + (7 * var(--ui-palette-hue-rotate-by))) )

ui-color-9.$description: Step 9 of the palette, at 53% lightness.
ui-color-9.$value: oklch( from var(--ui-palette-source) 53% calc(0.2 * (c / 0.21)) calc(h + (8 * var(--ui-palette-hue-rotate-by))) )

ui-color-10.$description: Step 10 of the palette, at 49% lightness.
ui-color-10.$value: oklch( from var(--ui-palette-source) 49% calc(0.19 * (c / 0.21)) calc(h + (9 * var(--ui-palette-hue-rotate-by))) )

ui-color-11.$description: Step 11 of the palette, at 42% lightness.
ui-color-11.$value: oklch( from var(--ui-palette-source) 42% calc(0.17 * (c / 0.21)) calc(h + (10 * var(--ui-palette-hue-rotate-by))) )

ui-color-12.$description: Step 12 of the palette, at 35% lightness.
ui-color-12.$value: oklch( from var(--ui-palette-source) 35% calc(0.15 * (c / 0.21)) calc(h + (11 * var(--ui-palette-hue-rotate-by))) )

ui-color-13.$description: Step 13 of the palette, at 27% lightness.
ui-color-13.$value: oklch( from var(--ui-palette-source) 27% calc(0.12 * (c / 0.21)) calc(h + (12 * var(--ui-palette-hue-rotate-by))) )

ui-color-14.$description: Step 14 of the palette, at 20% lightness.
ui-color-14.$value: oklch( from var(--ui-palette-source) 20% calc(0.09 * (c / 0.21)) calc(h + (13 * var(--ui-palette-hue-rotate-by))) )

ui-color-15.$description: Step 15 of the palette, at 16% lightness.
ui-color-15.$value: oklch( from var(--ui-palette-source) 16% calc(0.07 * (c / 0.21)) calc(h + (14 * var(--ui-palette-hue-rotate-by))) )

ui-color-16.$description: Step 16 of the palette, at 10% lightness.
ui-color-16.$value: oklch( from var(--ui-palette-source) 10% calc(0.05 * (c / 0.21)) calc(h + (15 * var(--ui-palette-hue-rotate-by))) )

ui-gray-1.$description: Step 1 of the gray palette: the lightness of `--ui-color-1` at `--ui-gray-chroma` and `--ui-gray-hue`.
ui-gray-1.$value: oklch( from var(--ui-color-1) l var(--ui-gray-chroma) var(--ui-gray-hue) )

ui-gray-2.$description: Step 2 of the gray palette: the lightness of `--ui-color-2` at `--ui-gray-chroma` and `--ui-gray-hue`.
ui-gray-2.$value: oklch( from var(--ui-color-2) l var(--ui-gray-chroma) var(--ui-gray-hue) )

ui-gray-3.$description: Step 3 of the gray palette: the lightness of `--ui-color-3` at `--ui-gray-chroma` and `--ui-gray-hue`.
ui-gray-3.$value: oklch( from var(--ui-color-3) l var(--ui-gray-chroma) var(--ui-gray-hue) )

ui-gray-4.$description: Step 4 of the gray palette: the lightness of `--ui-color-4` at `--ui-gray-chroma` and `--ui-gray-hue`.
ui-gray-4.$value: oklch( from var(--ui-color-4) l var(--ui-gray-chroma) var(--ui-gray-hue) )

ui-gray-5.$description: Step 5 of the gray palette: the lightness of `--ui-color-5` at `--ui-gray-chroma` and `--ui-gray-hue`.
ui-gray-5.$value: oklch( from var(--ui-color-5) l var(--ui-gray-chroma) var(--ui-gray-hue) )

ui-gray-6.$description: Step 6 of the gray palette: the lightness of `--ui-color-6` at `--ui-gray-chroma` and `--ui-gray-hue`.
ui-gray-6.$value: oklch( from var(--ui-color-6) l var(--ui-gray-chroma) var(--ui-gray-hue) )

ui-gray-7.$description: Step 7 of the gray palette: the lightness of `--ui-color-7` at `--ui-gray-chroma` and `--ui-gray-hue`.
ui-gray-7.$value: oklch( from var(--ui-color-7) l var(--ui-gray-chroma) var(--ui-gray-hue) )

ui-gray-8.$description: Step 8 of the gray palette: the lightness of `--ui-color-8` at `--ui-gray-chroma` and `--ui-gray-hue`.
ui-gray-8.$value: oklch( from var(--ui-color-8) l var(--ui-gray-chroma) var(--ui-gray-hue) )

ui-gray-9.$description: Step 9 of the gray palette: the lightness of `--ui-color-9` at `--ui-gray-chroma` and `--ui-gray-hue`.
ui-gray-9.$value: oklch( from var(--ui-color-9) l var(--ui-gray-chroma) var(--ui-gray-hue) )

ui-gray-10.$description: Step 10 of the gray palette: the lightness of `--ui-color-10` at `--ui-gray-chroma` and `--ui-gray-hue`.
ui-gray-10.$value: oklch( from var(--ui-color-10) l var(--ui-gray-chroma) var(--ui-gray-hue) )

ui-gray-11.$description: Step 11 of the gray palette: the lightness of `--ui-color-11` at `--ui-gray-chroma` and `--ui-gray-hue`.
ui-gray-11.$value: oklch( from var(--ui-color-11) l var(--ui-gray-chroma) var(--ui-gray-hue) )

ui-gray-12.$description: Step 12 of the gray palette: the lightness of `--ui-color-12` at `--ui-gray-chroma` and `--ui-gray-hue`.
ui-gray-12.$value: oklch( from var(--ui-color-12) l var(--ui-gray-chroma) var(--ui-gray-hue) )

ui-gray-13.$description: Step 13 of the gray palette: the lightness of `--ui-color-13` at `--ui-gray-chroma` and `--ui-gray-hue`.
ui-gray-13.$value: oklch( from var(--ui-color-13) l var(--ui-gray-chroma) var(--ui-gray-hue) )

ui-gray-14.$description: Step 14 of the gray palette: the lightness of `--ui-color-14` at `--ui-gray-chroma` and `--ui-gray-hue`.
ui-gray-14.$value: oklch( from var(--ui-color-14) l var(--ui-gray-chroma) var(--ui-gray-hue) )

ui-gray-15.$description: Step 15 of the gray palette: the lightness of `--ui-color-15` at `--ui-gray-chroma` and `--ui-gray-hue`.
ui-gray-15.$value: oklch( from var(--ui-color-15) l var(--ui-gray-chroma) var(--ui-gray-hue) )

ui-gray-16.$description: Step 16 of the gray palette: the lightness of `--ui-color-16` at `--ui-gray-chroma` and `--ui-gray-hue`.
ui-gray-16.$value: oklch( from var(--ui-color-16) l var(--ui-gray-chroma) var(--ui-gray-hue) )

ui-palette-accent.$description: The accent shade of the current palette: `Callout` icons and outlined borders. Stronger with more contrast. The severity `Chip` dot reads it. Re-derived inside every severity scope, so `.ui-success` gets a green one.
ui-palette-accent.$value: light-dark( oklch(from var(--ui-color-9) min(l, var(--ui-accent-max-lightness)) c h), oklch( from var(--ui-color-7) max(l, var(--ui-palette-accent-min-lightness)) c h ) )

ui-palette-border.$description: The border shade of the current palette: tonal `Callout` borders. Stronger with more contrast. Severity `Chip` borders read it. Re-derived inside every severity scope.
ui-palette-border.$value: light-dark( oklch( from var(--ui-color-5) min(l, var(--ui-palette-border-max-lightness)) c h ), oklch( from var(--ui-color-11) max(l, var(--ui-palette-border-min-lightness)) c h ) )

ui-palette-strong.$description: The strongest shade of the current palette, the darkest in light mode and the lightest in dark mode, with the most contrast against the page: `Callout` text, the default `Button` fill when `--ui-button-accent` is unset. Severity `Chip` text reads it. Re-derived inside every severity scope.

ui-palette-text.$description: A readable text shade of the current palette, at least `--ui-palette-text-min-lightness` in dark mode. Darker in light mode and lighter in dark mode with more contrast. Re-derived inside every severity scope.
ui-palette-text.$value: light-dark( oklch( from var(--ui-color-11) min(l, var(--ui-palette-text-max-lightness)) c h ), oklch( from var(--ui-color-6) max(l, var(--ui-palette-text-min-lightness)) min(c, var(--ui-accent-max-chroma)) h ) )

ui-palette-tint.$description: The tonal fill of the current palette: primary and critical tonal buttons when `--ui-primary-tonal` is unset. Stronger with more contrast. Re-derived inside every severity scope.
ui-palette-tint.$value: light-dark( oklch( from var(--ui-color-6) max(l, var(--ui-palette-tint-min-lightness)) c h ), oklch( from var(--ui-color-11) min(l, var(--ui-palette-tint-max-lightness)) c h ) )

ui-palette-tint-subtle.$description: A faint fill of the current palette: tonal severity `Callout`s. Tonal severity `Chip`s read it. Re-derived inside every severity scope.
ui-palette-tint-subtle.$value: light-dark( oklch(from var(--ui-color-3) l c h / 60%), oklch(from var(--ui-color-6) l c h / 5%) )

ui-blue.$description: A literal blue, hue 240 at `0.53`, the lightness of palette step 9 in every palette. No severity meaning.

ui-green.$description: A literal green, hue 145 at `0.53`, the lightness of palette step 9 in every palette. No severity meaning.

ui-orange.$description: A literal orange, hue 75 at `0.66`, the lightness of palette step 7 in every palette. No severity meaning.

ui-red.$description: A literal red, hue 25 at `0.53`, the lightness of palette step 9 in every palette. No severity meaning.

ui-critical.$description: Severity color for errors and destructive actions.

ui-critical-text.$description: Critical as a text color: the `.ui-critical` items of a `Menu`, a `.ui-critical` `Button` with no variant or `.ui-outlined`, and `del` and `.ui-del` text. `--ui-critical` with its lightness kept within `--ui-text-max-lightness` and `--ui-text-min-lightness`.
ui-critical-text.$value: light-dark( oklch(from var(--ui-critical) min(l, var(--ui-text-max-lightness)) c h), oklch( from var(--ui-critical) max(l, var(--ui-text-min-lightness)) min(c, var(--ui-text-max-chroma)) h ) )

ui-info.$description: Severity color for informational messages, and the dotted underline of `abbr`, `dfn`, `.ui-abbr` and `.ui-dfn`.

ui-info-text.$description: Info as a text color, for informational text outside an `.ui-info` scope. `--ui-info` with its lightness kept within `--ui-text-max-lightness` and `--ui-text-min-lightness`.
ui-info-text.$value: light-dark( oklch(from var(--ui-info) min(l, var(--ui-text-max-lightness)) c h), oklch( from var(--ui-info) max(l, var(--ui-text-min-lightness)) min(c, var(--ui-text-max-chroma)) h ) )

ui-invalid.$description: Color for invalid field borders, fills and outlines. Lifted to `--ui-invalid-min-lightness` in dark mode, so invalid borders stand out from the page with more contrast.
ui-invalid.$value: light-dark( var(--ui-critical), oklch( from var(--ui-critical) max(l, var(--ui-invalid-min-lightness)) min(c, var(--ui-accent-max-chroma)) h ) )

ui-invalid-text.$description: Color for validation messages and invalid labels. `--ui-invalid` with its lightness kept within `--ui-text-max-lightness` and `--ui-text-min-lightness`, so it stays readable where `--ui-invalid` is lighter for borders.
ui-invalid-text.$value: light-dark( oklch(from var(--ui-invalid) min(l, var(--ui-text-max-lightness)) c h), oklch( from var(--ui-invalid) max(l, var(--ui-text-min-lightness)) min(c, var(--ui-text-max-chroma)) h ) )

ui-neutral.$description: Severity color for neutral messages. `--ui-gray-hue` and `--ui-gray-chroma` at `0.53`, the lightness of `--ui-gray-9`, capped at `--ui-accent-max-lightness` in light mode. The `.ui-neutral` scope derives its palette from its hue and chroma.
ui-neutral.$value: light-dark( oklch( min(0.53, var(--ui-accent-max-lightness)) var(--ui-gray-chroma) var(--ui-gray-hue) ), oklch(0.53 var(--ui-gray-chroma) var(--ui-gray-hue)) )

ui-neutral-text.$description: Neutral as a text color, for neutral text outside an `.ui-neutral` scope. `--ui-neutral` with its lightness kept within `--ui-text-max-lightness` and `--ui-text-min-lightness`.
ui-neutral-text.$value: light-dark( oklch(from var(--ui-neutral) min(l, var(--ui-text-max-lightness)) c h), oklch( from var(--ui-neutral) max(l, var(--ui-text-min-lightness)) min(c, var(--ui-text-max-chroma)) h ) )

ui-success-text.$description: Success as a text color, for success text outside an `.ui-success` scope, and `ins` and `.ui-ins` text. `--ui-success` with its lightness kept within `--ui-text-max-lightness` and `--ui-text-min-lightness`.
ui-success-text.$value: light-dark( oklch(from var(--ui-success) min(l, var(--ui-text-max-lightness)) c h), oklch( from var(--ui-success) max(l, var(--ui-text-min-lightness)) min(c, var(--ui-text-max-chroma)) h ) )

ui-warning.$description: Severity color for warnings. Unlike the other severities it keeps its lightness with more contrast: the fill is light and takes dark `--ui-on-warning` text, and `--ui-warning-text` gets the stricter lightness limits instead.

ui-on-warning.$description: Text color on a `--ui-warning` fill: the warning `Badge`. White on a warning below 0.182 relative luminance and near-black above it, like `--ui-on-primary`.

ui-warning-text.$description: Warning as a text color, for warning text outside a `.ui-warning` scope. `--ui-warning` with its lightness kept within `--ui-text-max-lightness` and `--ui-text-min-lightness`.
ui-warning-text.$value: light-dark( oklch(from var(--ui-warning) min(l, var(--ui-text-max-lightness)) c h), oklch( from var(--ui-warning) max(l, var(--ui-text-min-lightness)) min(c, var(--ui-text-max-chroma)) h ) )

ui-primary-source.$description: The brand color `--ui-primary` is derived from, within `--ui-primary-max-lightness` and `--ui-primary-min-lightness`. Set it to a theme's brand color so more contrast can darken or lighten it while keeping its hue. Setting `--ui-primary` directly pins the color in every contrast mode.
ui-primary-source.$value: light-dark( oklch( from var(--ui-palette-source) 0.499 min(0.191, calc(0.382 * (c / 0.21))) h ), var(--ui-color-6) )

ui-primary.$description: Brand color for primary actions and accents. Derived from `--ui-primary-source` within `--ui-primary-max-lightness` and `--ui-primary-min-lightness`. Set `--ui-primary-source` to keep more contrast working, or this token to pin the color.
ui-primary.$value: light-dark( oklch( from var(--ui-primary-source) min(l, var(--ui-primary-max-lightness)) c h ), oklch( from var(--ui-primary-source) max(l, var(--ui-primary-min-lightness)) min(c, var(--ui-accent-max-chroma)) h ) )

ui-on-primary.$description: Text color on `--ui-primary`. Derived with relative color from the primary's relative luminance (the `y` of `xyz-d65`): white on a primary below 0.182, near-black above it, so either side keeps 4.5:1 and a custom `--ui-primary` gets readable text.

ui-primary-text.$description: Primary as a text color: links, rich text links, `Callout` link hover, `Button` and `ButtonGroup` with `.ui-primary` and no variant or `.ui-outlined`, and a selected `Select` option. Defaults to `--ui-primary` with its lightness kept within `--ui-text-max-lightness` and `--ui-text-min-lightness`, and is derived again from the more-contrast primary. Set it when the primary needs another shade for text.
ui-primary-text.$value: light-dark( oklch(from var(--ui-primary) min(l, var(--ui-text-max-lightness)) c h), oklch( from var(--ui-primary) max(l, var(--ui-text-min-lightness)) min(c, var(--ui-text-max-chroma)) h ) )

ui-primary-tonal.$description: Background of `Button` and `ButtonGroup` with `.ui-primary` and `.ui-tonal`, and of a checked `Checkbox`, `Radio` or `Switch` card. When unset, buttons use `--ui-palette-tint` and cards `--ui-primary` at `--ui-state-active-alpha-accent`. Material's `primary-container` and shadcn's `secondary` go here.

ui-on-primary-tonal.$description: Text color on `--ui-primary-tonal`. Set it with `--ui-primary-tonal`.

ui-selected-strong.$description: Mark of a selected item that has to stand out from the page on its own: the current `Carousel` marker, the bar on the start edge of a selected `List` row and the selected tab of filled `Tabs`. Defaults to `--ui-primary`. `--ui-selected` is the fill behind a selected item and may be faint.

ui-on-selected-strong.$description: Text color on `--ui-selected-strong`: the selected tab of filled `Tabs`. Defaults to `--ui-on-primary`.

ui-text-strong.$description: Strongest text color, for headings, labels and values. Body text is `--ui-text`.

ui-text.$description: Body text color. `--ui-text-strong` mixed into `--ui-surface` at `--ui-text-strength-light` or `--ui-text-strength-dark`.
ui-text.$value: light-dark( color-mix( in oklch, var(--ui-text-strong) var(--ui-text-strength-light), var(--ui-surface) ), color-mix( in oklch, var(--ui-text-strong) var(--ui-text-strength-dark), var(--ui-surface) ) )

ui-text-subtle.$description: Secondary text: placeholders, field helper text, overlines, descriptions in `List` and `Menu` items, unselected `Tabs` labels and `Table` captions. `--ui-text` unless a theme sets it.

ui-text-disabled.$description: Text color of disabled buttons and chips. `--ui-text` mixed into `--ui-surface` at `--ui-text-disabled-strength`. Also the label and border of an unchecked disabled `ToggleButton`.
ui-text-disabled.$value: color-mix( in oklch, var(--ui-text) var(--ui-text-disabled-strength), var(--ui-surface) )

ui-on-fill.$description: Text on an intent fill: an intent color with its lightness capped so light text reads on it, within `--ui-accent-fill-max-lightness` for critical `Button`s and the critical, info, neutral and success `Badge`, and within `--ui-choice-fill-max-lightness` for the invalid choice mark and the checked one in dark mode. Near-white in both modes. The fill has no token of its own, since each intent is one. Not `--ui-palette-on-strong`, which turns dark in dark mode for the light `--ui-palette-strong`.

against: oklch(from var(--ui-critical) min(l, var(--ui-accent-fill-max-lightness)) c h)
oklch(from var(--ui-info) min(l, var(--ui-accent-fill-max-lightness)) c h)
oklch(from var(--ui-neutral) min(l, var(--ui-accent-fill-max-lightness)) c h)
oklch(from var(--ui-success) min(l, var(--ui-accent-fill-max-lightness)) c h)

ui-surface-elevated.$description: Background of elevated cards and accordions, dialogs, drawers, menus and native `Select` options.

ui-surface-filled.$description: Background of filled areas such as progress tracks and table stripes.

ui-surface-inverse.$description: Background of `Tooltip`, the `Carousel` buttons and `kbd`, `var`, `.ui-kbd` and `.ui-var`, inverted against the page.

ui-surface-tonal-hover.$description: Hover fill of a `--ui-surface-tonal` surface: clickable `Chip`s and filled `TextField`, `Select` and `Textarea` fields. Derived from `--ui-surface-tonal`, darker in light mode and lighter in dark mode.
ui-surface-tonal-hover.$value: light-dark( oklch(from var(--ui-surface-tonal) calc(l * 0.93) c h), oklch(from var(--ui-surface-tonal) calc(l * 1.1) c h) )

ui-radius.$description: Corner radius for every component: cards, callouts, menus, buttons and fields follow it, and small parts like `kbd`, tooltips and checkboxes never get rounder than it. Set it to `0` for square corners. Takes a single length.

ui-border-width.$description: Default border width for components that draw a border.

ui-border-width-thick.$description: Width of emphasized rules: the head and foot rules of rich text tables, the `AvatarGroup` ring, the `Badge` border, the neutral `Chip` dot, the dotted `DescriptionList` rule, the `Tabs` indicator, the bar on a selected `List` row, the `Spinner` ring, and at one and a half times, the blockquote bar.

ui-radius-round.$description: The pill radius for round buttons, avatars, badges, chips, radios, switches, the range track and the carousel buttons and markers.

ui-chip-radius.$description: Corner radius for `Chip`. When unset, chips follow `--ui-radius`.

ui-dialog-radius.$description: Corner radius for `Dialog`. When unset, dialogs follow `--ui-radius`.

ui-menu-radius.$description: Corner radius for `Menu`. When unset, menus follow `--ui-radius`.

ui-radius-large.$description: Corner radius for large surfaces, such as cards and dialogs that want more rounding than controls. `--ui-radius` times 1.5, so `0` still squares it. Not read by a component yet.

ui-radius-small.$description: Corner radius of small parts: `kbd`, inline `code`, `mark`, `var`, `Tooltip`, the file input and a square `Avatar` image. `--ui-radius`, capped at 5px.

ui-radius-x-small.$description: Corner radius of the `Checkbox` box. `--ui-radius`, capped at 2px.

ui-border-color.$description: Default border color for cards, lists, tables and dividers. `--ui-text-strong` mixed into `--ui-surface` at `--ui-border-strength-light` or `--ui-border-strength-dark`.
ui-border-color.$value: light-dark( color-mix( in oklch, var(--ui-text-strong) var(--ui-border-strength-light), var(--ui-surface) ), color-mix( in oklch, var(--ui-text-strong) var(--ui-border-strength-dark), var(--ui-surface) ) )

ui-border-color-on-filled.$description: Border color inside filled surfaces: lists without a variant and table headers. `List` and `Table` set `--ui-border-color` to it on those parts.

ui-border-color-on-raised.$description: Borders drawn inside a raised surface (tonal and elevated `Card` and `Accordion`, `Dialog`, `Drawer`, `Menu`, the `Select` picker and `Callout` without a severity): dividers, separators, outlined controls. The same mix as `--ui-border-color` by default. Each raised component sets `--ui-border-color` to it on its root, so a theme that wants another border inside raised surfaces sets this one. The edge of the surface itself is `--ui-border-color-raised`.
ui-border-color-on-raised.$value: light-dark( color-mix( in oklch, var(--ui-text-strong) var(--ui-border-strength-light), var(--ui-surface) ), color-mix( in oklch, var(--ui-text-strong) var(--ui-border-strength-dark), var(--ui-surface) ) )

ui-border-color-raised.$description: The edge of every raised surface: tonal and elevated `Card`, `Accordion` and `Dialog`, `Callout` without a severity, `Drawer`, `Menu` and the `Select` picker. Set it to outline them all at once, or to `transparent` to drop their edges. When unset, each keeps its own edge: cards, accordions and dialogs the page background, so they stay visible on tonal surfaces, callouts their tonal background, and drawers, menus and the picker `--ui-border-color-on-raised`. The borders inside a raised surface are `--ui-border-color-on-raised`.

ui-field-radius.$description: Corner radius for fields. When unset, they follow `--ui-radius`, also where it's set on a part of the page.

ui-field-bg-color.$description: Background of `TextField`, `Textarea` and `Select` fields. When unset, `--ui-surface`, the page color.

ui-field-padding-inline.$description: Horizontal padding inside `TextField`, `Textarea` and `Select` fields. When unset, `--ui-space-2`. `.ui-large` reads `--ui-field-padding-inline-large`.

ui-field-padding-inline-large.$description: Horizontal padding inside `TextField`, `Textarea` and `Select` fields with `.ui-large`. When unset, `--ui-space-3`.

ui-field-placeholder-text-color.$description: Color of placeholder text in fields. When unset, `--ui-text-subtle`.

ui-field-helper-text-color.$description: Text color for helper and end text under a field.

ui-field-helper-font-size.$description: Font size for helper and end text under a field.

ui-field-helper-line-height.$description: Line height for helper and end text under a field.

ui-field-label-font-weight.$description: Font weight for emphasized field labels and legends.

ui-field-border-color.$description: Border color of every empty control: `TextField`, `Select`, `Textarea`, the unchecked `Checkbox`, `Radio` and `Switch` unless `--ui-choice-border-color` is set, the `Range` track and the `Progress` outline. `--ui-text-strong` mixed into `--ui-surface` at `--ui-field-border-strength`, so it reaches 3:1. Lighter than `--ui-border-color`, which is decorative, is a choice a theme can make.
ui-field-border-color.$value: color-mix( in oklch, var(--ui-text-strong) var(--ui-field-border-strength), var(--ui-surface) )

ui-field-border-color-on-filled.$description: Field border color inside filled surfaces: lists without a variant and table headers. `--ui-text-strong` mixed into `--ui-surface-filled` at `--ui-field-border-strength`.
ui-field-border-color-on-filled.$value: color-mix( in oklch, var(--ui-text-strong) var(--ui-field-border-strength), var(--ui-surface-filled) )

ui-field-border-color-on-raised.$description: Field border color inside raised surfaces. The same mix as `--ui-field-border-color` by default. Each raised component sets `--ui-field-border-color` to it on its root.
ui-field-border-color-on-raised.$value: color-mix( in oklch, var(--ui-text-strong) var(--ui-field-border-strength), var(--ui-surface) )

ui-focus-ring-offset.$description: Distance between a control and its focus ring.

ui-focus-ring-style.$description: Outline style of the focus ring.

ui-focus-ring-color.$description: Color of the keyboard focus ring. Black on surfaces lighter than OKLCH 0.6 and white on darker ones, so it reaches 3:1 on any `--ui-surface`.

ui-focus-ring-inset.$description: Negative offset for focus rings drawn inside a control, such as `ButtonGroup`, `List` items and `Select` options.

ui-font-body.$description: Font family for body text, fields and buttons. `system-ui, sans-serif` by default.

ui-font-code.$description: Font family for `code`, `kbd`, `samp` and `pre` in rich text, `.ui-kbd`, `.ui-samp`, `.ui-var`, code blocks and `kbd` in buttons and lists. A monospace stack by default.
ui-font-code.$value: Dank Mono, Operator Mono, Inconsolata, Fira Mono, ui-monospace, SF Mono, Monaco, Droid Sans Mono, Source Code Pro, Cascadia Code, Menlo, Consolas, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

ui-font-heading.$description: Font family for `h1`–`h6` and the `.ui-h1`–`.ui-h6` classes. When unset, headings follow `--ui-font-body`.

ui-font-size-100.$description: The smallest step of the type scale, 12px. `--ui-font-size-caption` reads it. Set the steps to reshape every size at once, or a role to move one.

ui-font-size-300.$description: Type scale step, 16px. `--ui-font-size-body`, `--ui-font-size-control` and `--ui-font-size-h6` read it.

ui-font-size-400.$description: Type scale step, 18px. `--ui-font-size-h5` reads it, and `--ui-font-size-h4` grows from it.

ui-font-size-500.$description: Type scale step, 20px. `--ui-font-size-large` reads it, `--ui-font-size-h3` grows from it and `--ui-font-size-h4` grows to it.

ui-font-size-600.$description: Type scale step, 24px. `--ui-font-size-h2` grows from it and `--ui-font-size-h3` grows to it.

ui-font-size-700.$description: Type scale step, 32px. `--ui-font-size-h1` grows from it.

ui-font-size-800.$description: Type scale step, 40px. `--ui-font-size-h2` grows to it.

ui-font-size-900.$description: The largest step of the type scale, 56px. `--ui-font-size-h1` grows to it.

ui-fluid-min-inline-size.$description: Viewport inline size where `--ui-fluid-progress` starts at 0 and the fluid heading sizes at their minimum, 20rem.

ui-fluid-max-inline-size.$description: Viewport inline size where `--ui-fluid-progress` reaches 1 and the fluid heading sizes their maximum, 48rem.

ui-font-weight-normal.$description: Font weight for body text, `List` text and `Button` keyboard shortcuts.

ui-font-weight-medium.$description: Font weight for badges, overlines and group labels.

ui-font-weight-semibold.$description: Font weight for labels, table headers and titles.

ui-font-weight-bold.$description: Font weight for headings, buttons and terms.

ui-letter-spacing-caps.$description: Letter spacing of uppercase text: overlines and the first paragraph of an `hgroup`.

ui-letter-spacing-display.$description: Letter spacing of `h1` and `h2`, tighter than the body.

ui-letter-spacing-heading.$description: Letter spacing of `h3` and `h4`, slightly tighter than the body.

ui-line-height-tight.$description: Line height of single-line controls and compact text: field inputs, `Table` cells, `Tooltip`, `Card` captions and keyboard hints in buttons.

ui-line-height-control.$description: Line height of interface text: labels, helpers, choice labels and field hints.

ui-line-height.$description: Line height of body copy: prose, captions and `List` text.

ui-line-height-relaxed.$description: Line height of the page text set on `html`, and of `Tabs` labels.

ui-rhythm-step.$description: Vertical rhythm unit. Rich text margins and heading line heights round to it.

ui-underline-offset.$description: Gap between text and its underline: `Link` and rich text links, and in Firefox `abbr`, `dfn`, `ins` and `u`.

ui-underline-offset-small.$description: Gap between text and the underline of `abbr`, `dfn`, `ins` and `u` and their classes. Firefox uses `--ui-underline-offset`.

ui-underline-thickness-hover.$description: Underline thickness of `Link` and rich text links on hover and keyboard focus. At rest they keep the font's own thickness.

ui-font-size-caption.$description: Font size of captions, `Badge`, `Chip`, `Divider` labels, `List` secondary text, `Menu` shortcuts, overlines, `small`, `figcaption` and x-small buttons, toggles and fields. Defaults to `--ui-font-size-100`.

ui-font-size-small.$description: Font size of helper text, `Callout`, `Table`, `Tooltip`, code blocks, dense `List` text and small buttons, chips, toggles and fields. Defaults to `--ui-font-size-200`.

ui-font-size-body.$description: Font size of body copy, `Card` text and the `Callout` title. Defaults to `--ui-font-size-300`.

ui-font-size-control.$description: Font size of the default `Button`, `Select`, `Tabs`, `TextField`, `Textarea` and `ToggleButton`. Small and x-small sizes read `--ui-font-size-small` and `--ui-font-size-caption`. Defaults to `--ui-font-size-300`.

ui-font-size-large.$description: Font size of lead paragraphs, `.ui-p.ui-large`, the `Drawer` title and large `Avatar` initials. Defaults to `--ui-font-size-500`.

ui-fluid-progress.$description: Position of the viewport inline size in the `--ui-fluid-min-inline-size` to `--ui-fluid-max-inline-size` window, 0 to 1, from `progress()`. `--ui-font-size-h1` to `--ui-font-size-h4` grow with it, and a theme can ramp other values on the same window.

ui-font-size-h1.$description: Font size for `h1` and `.ui-h1`. Grows from `--ui-font-size-700` to `--ui-font-size-900` with `--ui-fluid-progress`.

ui-font-size-h2.$description: Font size for `h2` and `.ui-h2`. Grows from `--ui-font-size-600` to `--ui-font-size-800` with `--ui-fluid-progress`.

ui-font-size-h3.$description: Font size for `h3` and `.ui-h3`. Grows from `--ui-font-size-500` to `--ui-font-size-600` with `--ui-fluid-progress`.

ui-font-size-h4.$description: Font size for `h4` and `.ui-h4`. Grows from `--ui-font-size-400` to `--ui-font-size-500` with `--ui-fluid-progress`.

ui-font-size-h5.$description: Font size for `h5` and `.ui-h5`. Defaults to `--ui-font-size-400`.

ui-font-size-h6.$description: Font size for `h6` and `.ui-h6`. Defaults to `--ui-font-size-300`.

ui-code-bg-color.$description: Background of inline `code` in rich text and `Typography`. `--ui-text` at `--ui-code-bg-alpha-light` in light mode and `--ui-code-bg-alpha-dark` in dark mode, fainter with more contrast so the text stands out.
ui-code-bg-color.$value: light-dark( oklch(from var(--ui-text) l c h / var(--ui-code-bg-alpha-light)), oklch(from var(--ui-text) l c h / var(--ui-code-bg-alpha-dark)) )

ui-code-block-bg-color.$description: Background of `pre.ui-code-block` and `pre` in rich text. `--ui-surface-inverse` in light mode and `--ui-surface-filled` in dark mode, so the block is dark in both.

ui-code-block-text-color.$description: Text color of `pre.ui-code-block` and `pre` in rich text. `--ui-on-inverse` in light mode and `--ui-text-strong` in dark mode, on `--ui-code-block-bg-color`.

ui-space-scale.$description: Multiplier for the `--ui-space-*` scale, the gaps, padding and margins of containers such as cards, dialogs, forms, tables and rich text. Controls follow `--ui-density` instead. See [Spacing](/guide/theming#spacing).

ui-card-padding.$description: Padding of `Card`, `Dialog`, `Drawer` and `Accordion` content, headers, footers and actions, and of `Checkbox`, `Radio` and `Switch` cards. When unset, `--ui-space-3`.

ui-list-item-padding-inline.$description: Horizontal padding of `List` and `Menu` items, headings and `Select` options. When unset, `--ui-space-3`.

ui-control-accent.$description: The accent every control shares: `Button` and `ButtonGroup` without `.ui-primary` or `.ui-critical`, a checked `Checkbox`, `Radio` and `Switch`, and the `Range` thumb and fill. Unset by default, so buttons keep `--ui-palette-strong` and choice controls `--ui-primary`. Set it to `--ui-primary` to give every control the brand color in one line, like Material and shadcn, and `--ui-button-accent` or `--ui-choice-accent` to override one of them.

ui-control-border-color.$description: Border color of controls without a fill: `Button` with `.ui-outlined`, the edge and dividers of an outlined `ButtonGroup`, `ToggleButton`, `ToggleGroup`, `Chip` with `.ui-outlined`, the track of `Tabs` with `.ui-outlined`, and the selected `Tabs` pill. When unset, outlined buttons use their color, the selected `Tabs` pill `--ui-field-border-color` and the rest `--ui-border-color`. Themes that outline controls like fields set it to `--ui-field-border-color`.

ui-control-border-color-filled.$description: Border color of controls with a fill: `Button` with `.ui-filled` or `.ui-tonal`, the edge and dividers of a `ButtonGroup` with one of them, a checked `ToggleButton`, `Chip` without `.ui-outlined` and the `Carousel` buttons. When unset, buttons have no visible border, the carousel buttons use a shade of their fill and the rest use `--ui-border-color`. Set it with `--ui-control-border-color` to outline every control.

ui-on-control-accent.$description: Text and mark color on a `--ui-control-accent` fill. Set it with `--ui-control-accent`. `--ui-button-on-accent` and `--ui-choice-on-accent` override it per component.

ui-track-bg-color.$description: The empty part of a track: the unchecked `Switch`, `Progress` and the `Range` track. When unset, `Progress` and tonal ranges use `--ui-surface-tonal`, the default range its field border and the switch `--ui-switch-track-bg-color`.

ui-density.$description: Multiplier for the control sizes: `--ui-control-size*`, `--ui-chip-size*`, `--ui-choice-size*` and the `Switch` thumb and track sizes. `0.875` is compact, `1.125` is comfortable. See [Density](/guide/theming#density).

ui-control-size-x-small.$description: Shared x-small height for fields and buttons.

ui-control-size-small.$description: Shared small height for fields and buttons.

ui-control-size.$description: Shared default height for fields and buttons so they line up.

ui-control-size-large.$description: Shared large height for fields and buttons.

ui-button-accent.$description: Color of `Button` and `ButtonGroup` without `.ui-primary` or `.ui-critical`: the fill of filled buttons, the text and border of outlined and text buttons. When unset, `--ui-control-accent`, else the darkest palette color in light mode and the lightest in dark mode.

ui-button-on-accent.$description: Text color on a filled `--ui-button-accent` button. Set it with `--ui-button-accent`. When unset, `--ui-on-control-accent`, else `--ui-palette-on-strong`.

ui-button-accent-filled.$description: Fill of `Button` and `ButtonGroup` with `.ui-filled` and no `.ui-primary` or `.ui-critical`, and of hovered outlined and tonal ones unless `--ui-button-hover` is `layer`. When unset, `--ui-button-accent`, so text, outlined and filled buttons share one color.

ui-button-on-accent-filled.$description: Text color on a `--ui-button-accent-filled` fill. Set it with `--ui-button-accent-filled`. When unset, `--ui-button-on-accent`.

ui-button-radius.$description: Corner radius for `Button`, `ButtonGroup`, `ToggleButton` and `ToggleGroup`. When unset, they follow `--ui-radius`, also where it's set on a part of the page.

ui-button-font-weight.$description: Font weight of `Button`. When unset, buttons follow `--ui-font-weight-bold`.

ui-button-hover.$description: How `Button` and `ButtonGroup` show hover and pressed states. `layer` draws a translucent state layer in `--ui-state-hover-alpha-accent` and `--ui-state-active-alpha-accent`: the text color over filled and tonal buttons, the accent over outlined ones, which keep their text and border. When unset (`shade`), filled buttons shade their fill and outlined and tonal buttons fill with the accent.

ui-button-hover-shadow.$description: Shadow of `Button` with `.ui-filled`, `.ui-outlined` or `.ui-tonal` on hover. When unset, it keeps `--ui-shadow-control`.

ui-button-hover-translate.$description: Moves `Button` with `.ui-filled`, `.ui-outlined` or `.ui-tonal` on hover, as a `translate` value. Pair it with `--ui-button-hover-shadow` to press buttons into their shadow. `none` when unset.

ui-button-padding-inline-x-small.$description: Horizontal padding of `Button` with `.ui-x-small`. When unset, `1ex`.

ui-button-padding-inline-small.$description: Horizontal padding of `Button` with `.ui-small`. When unset, `1.25ex`.

ui-button-padding-inline.$description: Horizontal padding of `Button`. When unset, `1.5ex`, which scales with the font.

ui-button-padding-inline-large.$description: Horizontal padding of `Button` with `.ui-large`. When unset, `2.5ex`.

ui-tabs-accent.$description: Color of the selected `Tabs` label, and of the indicator with `.ui-line`. When unset, `--ui-text-strong`. Filled tabs keep `--ui-on-selected-strong`.

ui-divider-gap.$description: Block margin around a `Divider`, times `--ui-space-scale`. Cards, callouts, dialogs and drawers set it to `--ui-space-3`. A divider that is a direct child of a card has no margin, since the card's gap already spaces it.

ui-duration-fast.$description: Transition duration for hover and press feedback.

ui-duration-slow.$description: Transition duration for entering and leaving overlays: `Dialog`, `Drawer` and `Menu`.

ui-ease-enter.$description: Easing for elements entering the screen: opening `Dialog`, `Drawer` and `Menu`, and the `Badge`, `Progress` and `Tooltip` transitions.

ui-ease-exit.$description: Easing for elements leaving the screen: closing `Dialog`, `Drawer` and `Menu`, and a dismissed toast.

ui-ease-move.$description: Easing for movement a theme may make springy: the `Checkbox` check, the `Radio` dot and the `Switch` thumb as they turn on, the `Tabs` indicator, the press scale, and `Menu`, `Select`, `Tooltip` and toasts as they open. Never for anything closing. When unset, each reads its own easing; a `linear()` spring with a little overshoot gives the controls some bounce.

ui-motion.$description: Motion multiplier. `0` disables transitions, `1` is normal speed. Set to `0` automatically under `prefers-reduced-motion`. See [Motion](/guide/theming#motion).

ui-press-scale.$description: Scale of `Button`, `ToggleButton` and button and link `Chip`s while pressed, over `--ui-duration` with `--ui-ease-move`. Unset, so pressing doesn't scale; `0.97` gives a light press. Buttons in a `ButtonGroup` and toggles in a `ToggleGroup` never scale.

ui-contrast.$description: `more` tightens the contrast knobs (`--ui-text-strength-*`, `--ui-border-strength-*`, `--ui-field-border-strength`, `--ui-code-bg-alpha-*`, the `*-max-lightness` and `*-min-lightness` limits and `--ui-focus-ring-width`), and every role derived from them follows. Set to `more` under `prefers-contrast: more` or by `.ui-contrast-more`. Components read it in style queries for shape changes. See [Contrast](/guide/theming#contrast).

ui-accent-fill-max-lightness.$description: The highest OKLCH lightness of an intent fill, an intent color filled under `--ui-on-fill` text: the critical, info, neutral and success `Badge`, and the fills of critical `Button`s, also in a critical `ButtonGroup`. Borders keep the intent color. `0.48`, and `0.45` with more contrast.

ui-accent-max-chroma.$description: The highest OKLCH chroma of `--ui-primary`, `--ui-invalid` and `--ui-palette-text` in dark mode when more contrast lifts them. `1` (no cap), and `0.1` with more contrast.

ui-accent-max-lightness.$description: The highest OKLCH lightness of the named colors, `--ui-neutral` and `--ui-palette-accent` in light mode. `1` (no cap), and `0.42` with more contrast.

ui-border-strength-dark.$description: How much of `--ui-text-strong` is mixed into `--ui-surface` for `--ui-border-color` in dark mode. `11%`, and `55%` with more contrast.

ui-border-strength-light.$description: How much of `--ui-text-strong` is mixed into `--ui-surface` for `--ui-border-color` in light mode. `17%`, and `55%` with more contrast.

ui-code-bg-alpha-dark.$description: Opacity of `--ui-code-bg-color`, the inline `code` background, in dark mode. `10%`, and `6%` with more contrast.

ui-code-bg-alpha-light.$description: Opacity of `--ui-code-bg-color`, the inline `code` background, in light mode. `12%`, and `6%` with more contrast.

ui-field-border-strength.$description: How much of `--ui-text-strong` is mixed into the surface for `--ui-field-border-color` and its filled and raised variants. `50%`, and `70%` with more contrast.

ui-invalid-min-lightness.$description: The lowest OKLCH lightness of `--ui-invalid` in dark mode. `0` (no floor), and `0.85` with more contrast, so invalid borders stand out from the page.

ui-palette-accent-min-lightness.$description: The lowest OKLCH lightness of `--ui-palette-accent` in dark mode. `0`, and `0.71` with more contrast.

ui-palette-border-max-lightness.$description: The highest OKLCH lightness of `--ui-palette-border` in light mode. `1`, and `0.53` with more contrast.

ui-palette-border-min-lightness.$description: The lowest OKLCH lightness of `--ui-palette-border` in dark mode. `0`, and `0.66` with more contrast.

ui-palette-text-max-lightness.$description: The highest OKLCH lightness of `--ui-palette-text` in light mode. `1`, and `0.35` with more contrast.

ui-palette-text-min-lightness.$description: The lowest OKLCH lightness of `--ui-palette-text` in dark mode, so it keeps 4.5:1 on every surface. `0.8` like `--ui-text-min-lightness`, and `0.93` with more contrast.

ui-palette-tint-max-lightness.$description: The highest OKLCH lightness of `--ui-palette-tint` in dark mode. `1`, and `0.35` with more contrast.

ui-palette-tint-min-lightness.$description: The lowest OKLCH lightness of `--ui-palette-tint` in light mode. `0`, and `0.84` with more contrast.

ui-primary-max-lightness.$description: The highest OKLCH lightness of `--ui-primary` in light mode, applied to `--ui-primary-source`. `1` (no cap), and `0.35` with more contrast.

ui-primary-min-lightness.$description: The lowest OKLCH lightness of `--ui-primary` in dark mode, applied to `--ui-primary-source`. `0` (no floor), and `0.93` with more contrast.

ui-text-disabled-strength.$description: How much of `--ui-text` is mixed into `--ui-surface` for `--ui-text-disabled`. `50%`, and `60%` with more contrast.

ui-text-max-chroma.$description: The highest OKLCH chroma of the intent text roles in dark mode, which keeps a light color inside sRGB. `0.1`. Also caps the dark mode text of `Button` and `ButtonGroup` without `.ui-primary` or `.ui-critical`.

ui-text-max-lightness.$description: The highest OKLCH lightness of the intent text roles (`--ui-primary-text`, `--ui-critical-text` and the other `-text` roles) in light mode, so they keep 4.5:1 on every surface. `0.41`, and `0.3` with more contrast.

ui-text-min-lightness.$description: The lowest OKLCH lightness of the intent text roles in dark mode, so they keep 4.5:1 on every surface. `0.8`, and `0.9` with more contrast. Their chroma is also capped at `--ui-text-max-chroma` in dark mode. Also the lowest lightness of `Button` and `ButtonGroup` text without `.ui-primary` or `.ui-critical` in dark mode.

ui-text-strength-dark.$description: How much of `--ui-text-strong` is mixed into `--ui-surface` for `--ui-text` in dark mode. `80%`, and `90%` with more contrast.

ui-text-strength-light.$description: How much of `--ui-text-strong` is mixed into `--ui-surface` for `--ui-text` in light mode. `87%`, and `90%` with more contrast.

ui-selected.$description: Background of a selected control: a checked `ToggleButton`, the selected `ToggleGroup` item, and a selected or current `List` item and `Select` option. When unset, `--ui-primary` on toggles and `--ui-primary` at `--ui-state-active-alpha-accent` on list items and options. Pair it with `--ui-on-selected`.

ui-on-selected.$description: Text color on `--ui-selected`. When unset, `--ui-on-primary` on toggles, the item's own text color on list items and `--ui-primary-text` on a selected `Select` option.

ui-state-active-alpha-light.$description: Alpha of the pressed state layer on neutral buttons in light mode.

ui-state-active-alpha-accent.$description: Alpha of the pressed state layer on primary and critical buttons.

ui-state-selected-alpha-accent.$description: Alpha of the primary tint behind selected `List` and `Menu` rows, `Select` options and checked `Checkbox`, `Radio` and `Switch` cards, when `--ui-selected` or `--ui-primary-tonal` is unset. `15%` with more contrast, so light text keeps 7:1 in dark mode.

ui-state-active-alpha-dark.$description: Alpha of the pressed state layer on neutral buttons in dark mode. `30%`, and `20%` with more contrast so the text keeps 7:1.

ui-state-hover-alpha-light.$description: Alpha of the hover state layer on neutral buttons in light mode.

ui-state-hover-alpha-accent.$description: Alpha of the hover state layer on primary and critical buttons.

ui-state-hover-alpha-dark.$description: Alpha of the hover state layer on neutral buttons in dark mode.

ui-icon-size-x-small.$description: Smallest icon size, for icons in x-small controls. Not read by a component yet.

ui-icon-size-small.$description: Icon size inside `Chip`, x-small `Avatar` and dense `List` rows, and the `Select` and autosuggest chevron.

ui-icon-size-large.$description: Icon size inside `Avatar`, and of an `svg` without a `width` in `normalize.css`.

ui-choice-accent.$description: Fill of a checked `Checkbox`, `Radio` and `Switch`, and the thumb and fill of `Range`. When unset, `--ui-control-accent`, else `--ui-primary`, with its lightness capped in dark mode for the choice controls. Set it, or `--ui-control-accent`, to `--ui-primary` for the plain primary, like Material and shadcn.

ui-choice-on-accent.$description: Color of the mark on a checked `Checkbox`, `Radio` and `Switch`. Set it with `--ui-choice-accent`. When unset, `--ui-on-control-accent`, else `--ui-on-primary` in light mode and near-white in dark mode.

ui-choice-border-color.$description: Border of the unchecked `Checkbox`, `Radio` and `Switch` track. When unset, `--ui-field-border-color`. Set it for themes whose field border is fainter than 3:1, like shadcn, which outlines its choices with `--ui-primary` like shadcn/ui does.

ui-choice-fill-max-lightness.$description: The highest OKLCH lightness of a checked `Checkbox`, `Radio` and `Switch` fill in dark mode, so the light mark keeps 3:1. `0.62`.

ui-choice-label-offset.$description: Moves `Checkbox`, `Radio` and `Switch` labels down (positive) or up (negative) against their control. Use `em` or `cap` to scale with the label font.

ui-choice-ripple-bg-color.$description: Halo color for the `Checkbox` and `Radio` hover effect. `--ui-text` at 20%.

ui-choice-size-small.$description: `Checkbox` and `Radio` input size with `.ui-small`, and in dense `List` rows unless the control has a size class.

ui-switch-thumb-size-small.$description: Diameter of the `Switch` thumb with `.ui-small`, and in `List` rows unless the switch has a size class.

ui-switch-track-block-size-small.$description: Height of the `Switch` track with `.ui-small`, and in `List` rows unless the switch has a size class.

ui-switch-track-inline-size-x-small.$description: Width of the `Switch` track with `.ui-x-small`. Twice `--ui-switch-track-block-size-x-small` until a theme sets it.

ui-switch-track-inline-size-small.$description: Width of the `Switch` track with `.ui-small`, and in `List` rows unless the switch has a size class. Twice `--ui-switch-track-block-size-small` until a theme sets it.

ui-switch-track-inline-size.$description: Width of the `Switch` track. Twice `--ui-switch-track-block-size` until a theme sets it.

ui-switch-track-inline-size-large.$description: Width of the `Switch` track with `.ui-large`. Twice `--ui-switch-track-block-size-large` until a theme sets it.

ui-switch-thumb-bg-color.$description: Color of the unchecked `Switch` thumb. The checked thumb uses `--ui-choice-on-accent`.

ui-switch-track-bg-color.$description: Background of the unchecked `Switch` track when `--ui-track-bg-color` is unset.

ui-shadow-control.$description: Shadow of buttons with a variant, standalone `ToggleButton`, outlined `Chip` and fields. `none` by default, for themes that lift controls off the page.

ui-shadow-field.$description: Shadow of `TextField`, `Textarea` and `Select` fields. When unset, they follow `--ui-shadow-control`. Set it to `none` to lift buttons but keep fields flat.

ui-shadow-surface.$description: Shadow of tonal and outlined `Card` and `Accordion`, and of `Callout`. `none` by default, for themes that put every surface on the same plane.

ui-shadow-color.$description: Color of every shadow, with its base opacity. Each layer of `--ui-shadow-elevated`, `--ui-shadow-overlay`, `--ui-shadow-scroll` and `--ui-shadow-selected` adds its own opacity on top, with relative color. `oklch(0.268 0.003 265 / 1%)` in light mode and `oklch(0.11 0.01 259 / 20%)` in dark mode, also in `.ui-light` and `.ui-dark` parts of the page.

ui-shadow-elevated.$description: Shadow of elevated `Card` and `Accordion`. Five layers of `--ui-shadow-color`, which follows the color scheme, also in `.ui-light` and `.ui-dark` parts of the page.
ui-shadow-elevated.$value: 0 -1px 3px 0 oklch(from var(--ui-shadow-color) l c h / calc(alpha + 0.02)), 0 1px 2px -5px oklch(from var(--ui-shadow-color) l c h / calc(alpha + 0.02)), 0 2px 5px -5px oklch(from var(--ui-shadow-color) l c h / calc(alpha + 0.04)), 0 4px 12px -5px oklch(from var(--ui-shadow-color) l c h / calc(alpha + 0.05)), 0 12px 15px -5px oklch(from var(--ui-shadow-color) l c h / calc(alpha + 0.07))

ui-shadow-overlay.$description: Shadow of layers that float above the page: `Dialog`, `Drawer`, `Menu`, `Select` pickers and the `Carousel` buttons. Five layers of `--ui-shadow-color`.
ui-shadow-overlay.$value: 0 -1px 3px 0 oklch(from var(--ui-shadow-color) l c h / calc(alpha + 0.02)), 0 1px 2px -5px oklch(from var(--ui-shadow-color) l c h / calc(alpha + 0.02)), 0 2px 5px -5px oklch(from var(--ui-shadow-color) l c h / calc(alpha + 0.04)), 0 4px 12px -5px oklch(from var(--ui-shadow-color) l c h / calc(alpha + 0.05)), 0 12px 15px -5px oklch(from var(--ui-shadow-color) l c h / calc(alpha + 0.07))

ui-shadow-scroll.$description: Shadow under the header and above the footer of a scrolled `Dialog` or `Drawer`, and under a sticky `Table` header. Six layers of `--ui-shadow-color`.
ui-shadow-scroll.$value: 0 -2px 5px 0 oklch(from var(--ui-shadow-color) l c h / calc(alpha + 0.02)), 0 1px 1px -2px oklch(from var(--ui-shadow-color) l c h / calc(alpha + 0.03)), 0 2px 2px -2px oklch(from var(--ui-shadow-color) l c h / calc(alpha + 0.03)), 0 5px 5px -2px oklch(from var(--ui-shadow-color) l c h / calc(alpha + 0.04)), 0 9px 9px -2px oklch(from var(--ui-shadow-color) l c h / calc(alpha + 0.05)), 0 16px 16px -2px oklch(from var(--ui-shadow-color) l c h / calc(alpha + 0.06))

ui-shadow-selected.$description: Shadow of the selected tab in default and `.ui-filled` `Tabs`. `.ui-line` and `.ui-outlined` have none. One layer of `--ui-shadow-color`.
ui-shadow-selected.$value: 0 1px 2px -1px oklch(from var(--ui-shadow-color) l c h / calc(alpha + 0.09))

ui-backdrop-blur.$description: Blur radius behind an open `Dialog` or `Drawer`.

ui-backdrop-bg-color.$description: Overlay color behind an open `Dialog` or `Drawer`. `--ui-text` at 50% in light mode, and half the lightness of `--ui-surface` at 50% in dark mode.
ui-backdrop-bg-color.$value: light-dark( oklch(from var(--ui-text) l c h / 50%), oklch(from var(--ui-surface) calc(l / 2) c h / 50%) )

ui-anchor-position-area.$description: The `position-area` of the floating content of an `Anchor`, a popover `Menu` or a `Tooltip`. The `positionArea` prop sets it on one instance, or set it on an element for everything inside it. When unset, each keeps its own: `self-start self-end` for `Anchor`, its `side` and `span` for `Menu` (`self-block-end span-self-inline-end`) and `self-block-start` for `Tooltip`.
